text: High Warlord's Pulverizer is a two-handed mace that can be purchased as a reward from PvP.
High Warlord's Bludgeon is a one-handed mace that can be purchased as a reward from PvP.
High Warlord's Battle Axe is an two-handed axe that can be purchased as a reward from PvP. Varok Saurfang wielded this axe until his model was updated in patch 7.3.5.

High Priestess MacDonnell is a human quest giver located at Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands. She is Commander Ashlam Valorfist's second-in-command and has been put in charge to counter the plague cauldrons that have been placed in the Plaguelands by the Scourge. Following the Battle for Lordaeron, she led an Alliance force into the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest where she was encountered by Horde champions.
High Warlord's Cleaver is an one-hand axe that can be purchased as a reward from PvP.
High Warlord's Razor is a one-handed dagger that can be purchased as a reward from PvP.
High Warlord's Right Claw is a main hand fist weapon that can be purchased as a reward from PvP.
High Warlord's Razor Claw is a off hand fist weapon that can be purchased as a reward from PvP.
High Warlord's Spellblade is a caster's dagger that can be purchased as a reward from PvP. =Source= The spellblade is purchased from in Hall of Legends, Orgrimmar for .

The High Wilderness is a vast forest that stretches from the Forgotten Coast to Verdantis River in western Feralas. Many creatures can be found in this forest, including but not limited to: bears, wolves, hippogryphs, yetis, treants, and ogres.
High Warlord was the highest PvP rank attainable in the pre-2.0 honor system. The Alliance equivalent was Grand Marshal (Legacy).
High Warlord's Tome of Destruction is an epic Off-hand that can be purchased as a PvP reward from in Hall of Legends, Orgrimmar for .
High Warlord's Tome of Mending is an epic Off-hand that can be purchased as a reward from PvP. =Source= High Warlord's Tome of Mending is purchased from in Hall of Legends, Orgrimmar for .
The High Test Eternium Fishing Line is an enchanted fishing line that will add +5 fishing to a fishing pole. This effect will not stack with other enchantments on the item.
High Warlord's Ripper was a PvP reward, and could be purchased for from in Hall of Legends.

__NOTOC__ High Priest Thel'danis is a night elf quest giver located at Uther's Tomb in the Western Plaguelands. He was able to purge scourgestones. Following Tirion Fordring's apparent death, Thel'danis created a barrier against the assaulting undead around the tomb. He was aided by Mehlar Dawnblade and the paladins of the Silver Hand.
High Robe of the Adjudicator is a quest reward from Assault on Fenris Isle.
__NOTOC__ High Nethermancer Zerevor is a blood elf boss located in the Chamber of Command in the Black Temple. He is also a member of the fearsome Illidari Council.
Highborne Lamenters are special, pleasantly voiced banshees that sing with Sylvanas Windrunner during the Lament of the Highborne event.
High Warlords Vestments is a Horde five piece PvP-70 Rogue set. Various pieces are availabe for purchase at from Lady Palanseer; located in the Hall of Legends, Orgrimmar.
Highland Bow is a quest reward from Return to Primal Torntusk.

:"I recommend you buy like there was no tomorrow. All I'm saying is, don't be caught dead in those outdated fashions! " :—Merchant Kendra An item collection. This is not a true set, there are no bonuses if you wear more than one or all pieces.
Highborne Relic Fragment are cracks in the ice on Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring. Opening them requires Jaron's Pick.

High Justice Harrold Grimstone appears when a player stands on the mesh circle at the center of the Ring of the Law inside Blackrock Depths. He is flagged red, but cannot be attacked; his purpose is to explain what happens during the Ring of Law boss event.
High Tinker Mekkatorque is a boss in the Battle of Dazar'alor raid. This encounter is part of the Battle of Dazar'alor raid where Alliance characters are transformed into soldiers of the Horde.
The Highborne Astrolabe is exhibited in the Ironforge museum.

High Inquisitor Valroth is the High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade. He keeps Koltira Deathweaver captive in the torture room of the Scarlet Hold in the Scarlet Enclave. He sends three waves of his acolytes at Death Knights attempting to free Deathweaver before attacking them himself. After players defeat him, Koltira casts Corpse Explosion on him, leaving him a smoldering pile of meat.
High Inquisitor Valroth's Remains fall to the basement floor of Scarlet Hold upon the death of High Inquisitor Valroth while on Bloody Breakout.
__NOTOC__ High Priestess Tua-Tua is one of the "so-called" worshippers that Quetz'lun's Spirit cursed and dragged into her underworld.
__NOTOC__ High Priest Mu'funu is one of the "so-called" worshippers that Quetz'lun's Spirit cursed and dragged into her underworld.
__NOTOC__ High Priest Hawinni is one of the so-called worshipers that Quetz'lun's Spirit cursed and dragged into her underworld.
High Priestess Hai'watna is a rare jungle troll found in one of the towers just outside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn where she seems to be channeling some kind of spell.
High Tinker Mekkatorque's Silver Coin is fished from the fountain in the Eventide district of Dalaran.
__NOTOC__ High Thane Jorfus is a rare elite vrykul located at either the Court of Bones, Sindragosa's Fall, or the Fleshwerks in Icecrown.

High Shaman Bloodpaw is a wolvar located at the Eldritch Heights in the Dragonblight. It is possible he is the leader of the Bloodpaw tribe. After the Bloodpaw tribe forced Drolfy and his cousins, Skrotee and Brote (whom Drolfy believes may have been captured or killed by the Bloodpaw) to flee from the heights, Drolfy put a bounty on his life to draw Alliance adventurers to venture to the heights and kill him.
High Priest Yath'amon is a nerubian vizier stationed at Scourgeholme in Icecrown. Jayde assist you in killing Yath'amon.
__NOTOC__ Highborne Summoners are Shen'dralar night elves maintaining the prison of Immol'thar which allow the Shen'dralar to siphon its energies. This prison is upheld via five pylons.
Highborne Relics dropped from the following ghosts in night elven ruins in Darkshore: *Cursed Highborne *Writhing Highborne *Wailing Highborne
High Priestess Azil is the fourth and final boss of the Stonecore.
High Priestess Siralen was, according to a plaque on her statue, promoted into service as Queen Azshara's personal high priestess of Vashj'ir after performing exceptionally in the Quel'Dormir Temple.
High Priest Benedictus Voss is the father of Lilian Voss. Before the Third War, Calia Menethil listened to his sermons. After that, he joined the Scarlet Crusade.

The Highborne Soul Mirror is a rare archaeology artifact that requires 150 skill to find and 100 Night Elf Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to three Highborne Scroll keystones may be used to complete it.

The Highborne Scroll is an archaeology keystone. It acts as 12 pieces of Night Elf Archaeology Fragments in research on Night elf archaeology finds that have 'sockets'. They can also be used in Cataclysm dungeons to grant a group wide buff. The buffs available are: *Throne of the Tides: Grants Waters of Elune, which is a 10 percent bonus damage against Naga.

High Priestess Lorthuna is one of the leaders to the Twilight's Hammer that is stationed in Deepholm. After the Twilight's Hammer is thinned out through the questing in Deepholm, she leads the final assault with the remaining Twilight forces on the Temple of Earth. She is able to kill Maruut Stonebinder, though as the situation looks bleak, Therazane and her forces arrive to assist the Earthen Ring. Therazane personally assists in the killing of Lorthuna, and the World Pillar is restored.
High Priestess Kilnara is a boss of the level 85 version of Zul'Gurub.
High Viscosity Coconut Milk is found inside Cracked Un'Goro Coconut and is an objective for Repairing A-Me 01.
Highborne Prison is provided as an objective for Arcane Legacy.
Highguard Elites are Highborne elven mobs that ride atop Shadowbats at the Shores of the Well in Well of Eternity. Once they are defeated Varo'then will become attackable.

The Highbank Lieutenant is part of a five-person squad that accompanies Alliance heroes on a small series of quests beginning at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands and ending within Wyrms' Bend. The Lieutenant is also a quest giver once he is summoned for If The Key Fits (Alliance).
The High Society Top Hat is created with Tailoring (75); taught by Pattern: High Society Top Hat.

The High King of the Alliance is the commander of all Alliance forces. Much like the Warchief of the Horde, it is a position that is trying to coordinate the actions of all the races in the Alliance. During the Battle for Broken Shore, Varian Wrynn died and the High King title is now associated with his son, Anduin Wrynn.
High Inquisitor Whitemane and compose the third and final boss encounter of the Scarlet Monastery.

High Sunreaver Mages are blood elf mages encountered by Jaina Proudmoore in the Violet Citadel during the quest Jaina's Resolution. She kills three of them after making her appearance, and slays two more after abducting Archmage Aethas Sunreaver from the citadel.
High Priestess Silthera is a naga located in Azshara. She holds Arkkoroc's heart to controls his sons.
High Tide is a Restoration shaman talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Primal Tide Core.

.]] High Warlord Volrath is the primary Horde general in Ashran, found in the Warspear Keep in Warspear Outpost. Rival of Grand Marshal Tremblade, he also serves as Elite Conquest gear vendor. He later captained a Horde gunship during the battle for Seething Shore. He also appears in the War Headguarters in the Mugambala in Zuldazar. Later, he appeared in Newhome in Nazjatar.

Highmaul is the capital of the Gorian Empire and a raid instance introduced in Warlords of Draenor which opened on December 2, 2014. It features 7 bosses, and serves as the first raid of the expansion. The entrance is in western . It is ogre-themed, showing them at the height of their civilization. The layout of the instance is nonlinear, allowing groups to select their own path of progression.
Hilda is a pandaren located at Nayeli Lagoon in Krasarang Wilds.
Highmaul Historian is a professions achievement earned for restoring and displaying pristine versions of all Ogre artifacts.
The Highmaul clan is an ogre clan found on . They are the main component of the Gorian Empire, and fought for generations against the .
Highmaul Guild Run is an achievement earned from defeating all of the bosses within Highmaul in a guild group on Normal difficulty or higher.
Highmaul Hops is one of the ingredients for the Ogre Brewing Kit.
Hilda Copperfuze is a gnome located at the Engineering Works in Stormshield.
Highmaul Relics are reputation items for the Steamwheedle Preservation Society. They can be traded to Sallee Silverclamp at the Ruins of Na'gwa for 350 reputation.

Highpass is a small outpost built in the center of Gorgrond and serves as a temporary base for the Rangari draenei and the Alliance led by the commander and Vindicator Maraad. The only major building in this outpost is decided by the commander, which is either the Highpass Logging Camp or the Highpass Sparring Ring. There is a command table here for completing and starting new garrison missions.
Highperch Pridelings are baby wyverns found across Highperch in Thousand Needles that have been captured by the Twilight's Hammer.
Highmaul Harbor is the shipyard for Highmaul. A Dreadnaught is docked here.
Highmaul Lockbox is mailed to players by Gharg when they lose the Highmaul Coliseum event.
Highmaul Reliquaries are chests found in the north-western section of .
Higs Blastscorch is goblin that pilots The Bogpaddle Bullet in the quest with the same name. He disappears immediately after arriving in Bogpaddle and he don't appear outside of this quest.
Highly Charged Mana Clog is quest reward for The Art of Flow.
Highlord is a title rewarded to paladins for completing Warriors of Light. The title will show before the character's name, in the following format: :Highlord

Highlands Runehorn are musken found in the western slopes of Stormheim.

The Hijacked Portal is a location just north of Deliverance Point. Illidari guard a large portal that Marius Felbane and Tehd Shoemaker have reversed in order to travel to areas Burning Legion troops occupy. The Dreadex, a Legion Command Ship, the Dreadsoul, and Bybeen Lair are accessed through the portal when their corresponding world quest is up.
Hildy Bufferpolish is an individual who engineered the Queen Mae during the Speedbarge Boat Race.

Hikkle Ricksprinkle is a goblin bruiser located in Gadgetzan. He was once interviewed by the Gadgetzan Times.
Hillborn Saurolisks are saurolisks located in Blushwater Brook in Tiragarde Sound.
Hillborn Broodmother is a saurolisk located in Foxhollow Woods in Tiragarde Sound. She appears after the two Grimestone Trappers have been dealt with, after inspecting the Suspicious Pile of Meat.
Hillcrest Farmhands are deceased humans located at Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley.
__NOTOC__ Highlands Maulers are wendigos located in the Wendigo Highlands in Stormsong Valley.
Highlands Grizzlies are bears located on Tidebreak Summit in Stormsong Valley.
The Highmaul Ambassador's Garb would have the user appear as a Highmaul Sorcerer.
Highlord's Judgment is a Retribution paladin artifact trait. It is linked to the Embrace the Light and Wrath of the Ashbringer traits.
